root_cause.statement: web/src/api/identity.ts's groupsApi hardcodes URL path literals under '/api/v1/admin/groups'. Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline NEVER mounts '/admin/groups'. It mounts forward("/identity", to: Letflow.Routers.Identity) at lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex:141, and the ONLY /admin-prefixed forward in the entire pipeline is forward("/admin/services", to: Letflow.Routers.AdminServices) at :154 -- Plug.Router forwards are prefix-exclusive, so it does not match '/admin/groups'. A request to /api/v1/admin/groups... therefore falls past every forward to ApiPipeline's own catch-all at lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex:203-205 -- 'match _ do Letflow.Api.Response.not_found(conn) end' -- i.e. a hard HTTP 404 with an RFC 9457 problem body, AFTER successful authentication.
root_cause.broken_invariant: Every client-side path literal in web/src/api/*.ts must correspond to a route actually mounted in lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex's forward table. Nothing enforces this: client.get/post/patch/delete take a plain `string`, so a nonexistent path is a perfectly well-typed program, and no build step, type, lint rule or test couples the two sides.
root_cause.why_existing_tests_did_not_catch_it: Both shipped regression tests (identity.removeMembers.test.ts, identity.usersRoles.test.ts) are per-function string assertions -- each asserts only the ONE function its own run fixed. Neither enumerates groupsApi, and nothing anywhere asserts the absence of the substring '/api/v1/admin/' across the module. GroupsPage.tsx's own component tests mock at the api-module / MSW layer, so they never exercise a real path. ISS-0782's suggested_fix names this exact gap in its own words: 'apparently none exists that runs against a real backend -- only mocked unit tests, which is exactly why this went undetected.'
root_cause.runtime_effect: web/src/api/client.ts throws an ApiError on any non-2xx; React Query surfaces it. In web/src/pages/admin/GroupsPage.tsx the primary groups list query (:47) therefore fails, rendererState resolves through classifyError(error) (:52), and the whole Groups admin screen renders its error state and never lists a group. The create (:67), add-member (:76) and delete (:97) mutations each 404 as well. This is the identical failure mode ISS-0782 observed live on the Users screen ('Something went wrong loading this content.').

response_shape_mismatches.severity: HIGH -- a naive prefix-only fix turns a silent 404 into an uncaught render-time TypeError
response_shape_mismatches.backend_actually_returns: handle_list_group_members/3 (lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex:543-568) calls Pagination.page_response(Enum.map(users, &user_map/1), next_cursor), which builds %Letflow.Api.Pagination.Page{items:, next_cursor:, count:} (lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex:171-173; struct at :72-89) whose encoder is '@derive {Jason.Encoder, only: [:items, :next_cursor, :count]}'. The wire body is an OBJECT: {"items": [...], "next_cursor": ..., "count": N}. The route is cursor-paginated and also accepts 'page_size' and 'cursor' query params, which the client never sends.
response_shape_mismatches.consumer_impact: web/src/pages/admin/GroupsPage.tsx consumes `members` as an array in three places: :103 '(members ?? []).map(...)', :223 '(members ?? []).length === 0', :227 '(members ?? []).map(...)'. Given an object, '.length' is undefined so the '=== 0' empty-state guard is FALSE, execution falls through to '.map', and 'members.map is not a function' throws during render -- the Manage-members dialog crashes. Today this is masked because the call 404s before any body is parsed. Fixing only the prefix UNMASKS it.
response_shape_mismatches.fix_needed: Either retype to the Page shape (items + next_cursor + count) and read '.items' at the three GroupsPage sites, OR unwrap '.items' inside the api function and keep the User[] signature. CODE-DESIGNER chooses. Note that cursor pagination means an unwrap silently caps the member list at the default page_size of 50 (Pagination.default_page_size/0, lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex:98-99).

response_shape_mismatches.client_promises: groupsApi.list(): Promise<PagedResponse<Group>> where PagedResponse = {items, total, page, page_size} (web/src/types/api.ts:21-26)
response_shape_mismatches.backend_actually_returns: handle_list_groups/2 (lib/letflow/routers/identity.ex:468-472) -> Response.ok(conn, %{"items" => [...], "total" => total}). 'page' and 'page_size' are NEVER emitted. The route takes no pagination params at all -- Identity.list_groups/1 takes opts only.
response_shape_mismatches.consumer_impact: Both consumers read only '.items' (GroupsPage.tsx:50, useAdminUsers.ts:47 via useAdminGroups), so nothing breaks today. Any future code trusting data.page_size silently gets undefined with no type error.
response_shape_mismatches.fix_needed: Optional. Narrow the return type to {items: Group[]; total: number}, or make page/page_size optional on PagedResponse. A decision for CODE-DESIGNER, not a requirement.

finding_1.title: usersApi.delete and usersApi.resetPassword call routes that exist at NO prefix -- ISS-0782's own fix was incomplete
finding_1.evidence: web/src/api/identity.ts:28 'POST /api/v1/users/${id}/reset-password' and :31 'DELETE /api/v1/users/${id}'. Runtime __authz_routes__() filtered to /users returns exactly five routes: POST /users, GET /users, GET /users/:id, PATCH /users/:id, POST /users/:id/status. There is no DELETE /users/:id and no reset-password route anywhere, at any prefix; and '/api/v1/users' is not a mounted forward at all (only /identity is). Zero production callers found in web/src.
finding_1.severity_suggestion: MINOR (dead code, no caller) -- but it is direct evidence that ISS-0782 closed while leaving the same defect class live in the same file.

finding_2.title: rolesApi.get/.create/.update/.delete/.grantPermission/.revokePermission all call the dead /api/v1/admin/roles prefix
finding_2.evidence: web/src/api/identity.ts:70-84. Runtime __authz_routes__() filtered to /roles returns exactly TWO routes: POST /api/v1/identity/roles and GET /api/v1/identity/roles. So rolesApi.create is WRONG-PREFIX (fixable) and .get/.update/.delete/.grantPermission/.revokePermission are NO-BACKEND-ROUTE-EXISTS. ISS-0782 corrected rolesApi.list only. Zero production callers for the six.
finding_2.severity_suggestion: MINOR to MAJOR at ORCH's discretion -- currently uncalled so no live breakage, but the same latent trap.

finding_3.title: GroupsPage 'Members' column always renders 0
finding_3.evidence: See caveat-2b. group_map/1 never emits member_count; groupMembers/1 defaults to 0.

finding_4.title: Nothing mechanically couples client path literals to the mounted route table, so a fourth recurrence is unprevented
finding_4.evidence: Three separate WF-03 runs (ISS-0736, ISS-0782, ISS-0765) have now corrected path literals in web/src/api/identity.ts one call site at a time, each shipping a per-function string test that guards only its own function. A cheap durable guard exists: Letflow.Routers.*.__authz_routes__() is already a machine-readable route table (it is exactly what this diagnosis used) and lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex's forwards supply the prefixes -- so a generated fixture plus one vitest asserting that every path literal in web/src/api/*.ts resolves against it would close the class outright. A far cheaper interim guard: a single test asserting the substring '/api/v1/admin/' appears in web/src/api/identity.ts ONLY for '/api/v1/admin/services'.
finding_4.severity_suggestion: MAJOR (process defect -- this is the thing that keeps costing whole pipeline runs)

what_the_fix_must_change: 1. web/src/api/identity.ts: replace the 5 live WRONG-PREFIX literals '/api/v1/admin/groups' -> '/api/v1/identity/groups' in .list, .create, .delete, .addMembers, .members. Leave .removeMembers untouched.

2. Decide the fate of .get and .update -- they have NO backend route at ANY prefix and NO Identity context function. Recommend deletion (zero callers). Do NOT 'correct' them to /api/v1/identity/groups/:id: that swaps a 404 at the pipeline catch-all for a 404 at Letflow.Routers.Identity's own 'match _', which is the same bug wearing a better prefix. This also means ISS-0765's fix_direction ('correct .get/.update to the real prefix') is not satisfiable as literally written.
3. Fix .members's response shape WITH the prefix change, not after it -- a prefix-only change makes GroupsPage.tsx:227 throw 'members.map is not a function'. Highest-risk item in the whole fix.
4. Recommended: rename .addMembers -> .addMember(id, userId: string) sending {user_id}, mirroring ISS-0736's removeMembers correction; the backend discards every id after the first.

5. Regression coverage (per ISS-0765's fix_direction): mirror web/src/api/__tests__/identity.removeMembers.test.ts. To close the class rather than add a third per-function guard, TEST-DESIGNER should write ONE table-driven test enumerating every groupsApi function, asserting its exact method+path and asserting that no emitted URL contains '/api/v1/admin/'. Per WF-03 Step 4 it must be shown to FAIL on the pre-fix commit -- it will, on 7 of 8 rows; the probe output recorded above IS the pre-fix measurement -- and PASS post-fix.
6. NO backend change. lib/ and priv/repo/migrations/ are untouched by this fix.

issues.description: RECURRENCE. web/src/api/identity.ts has already been corrected for this identical defect class twice (ISS-0736 -> removeMembers; ISS-0782 -> usersApi.list/get/create/update + rolesApi.list), and the defect still remains in 14 further functions across groupsApi/rolesApi/usersApi. Neither prior run audited the file. ISS-0765's 'related:' block does not mention ISS-0782 at all, because ISS-0782 was filed a day after ISS-0765. Fixing only the 7 named groupsApi functions makes this the third partial pass and leaves finding_1 and finding_2 live.

A prefix-only correction of groupsApi.members converts a silent 404 into a thrown TypeError in GroupsPage.tsx's Manage-members dialog ('(members ?? []).map' over a {items,next_cursor,count} object). The fix design MUST handle the response shape, not just the URL. Flagged explicitly because a literal reading of ISS-0765's fix_direction ('correct ... to the real prefix') would miss it.

groupsApi.get and groupsApi.update have no backend route at any prefix and no Letflow.Identity context function, so ISS-0765's fix_direction is not satisfiable as written for those two. CODE-DESIGNER must choose deletion, or a WF-01 requirement for new backend routes -- it cannot follow the issue's stated direction literally.
Incidental findings 1-4 require ORCH to register issues; ISSUE-FIXER does not allocate ids or call the queue/gh, per core-directives 'No Issue Left Local-Only'.
